231885.note: The Forest Service's point, 165 m east of the pin, is in open pine meadow 55 m south of the drawn road, like the pin itself; neither shows a pad, lane, toilet or fire ring that marks the group site. Not moved.

231887.note: The pin is in open juniper scrub 175 m from the only drawn road, and the listing's own point, 435 m north, is in juniper and pine too; neither shows a clearing, lane or pad for the group area.

231890.note: The pin is on a large building in the camp complex, and the drawn lanes reach it.

231892.note: The pin moved 778 m south-southeast onto the gravel pad of the group loop the photo shows in a meadow at the end of Holy Ghost Road, by the Forest Service's point. Once re-framed, the map draws OpenStreetMap's loop there, but its west arm runs up to 14 m out over the grass and its east arm about 5 m off the lane, so it stays held for a road trace (a trace of the loop alone would only double it).

231952.note: The pin sits in the open clearing inside the drawn loop, with the restrooms beside it, and the loop joins the road.

231970.note: The pin is on the bare cleared pad beside the road, and the drawn spur reaches it.

231971.note: The pin sits on a broad bare clearing 120 m east of the drawn parking loop and restroom; no lane to it shows clearly enough to trace.

231972.note: The pin is on the drawn loop in an open clearing in the junipers, and the loop joins the road.

231974.note: The pin sits on the open bare clearing at the end of the drawn road, where the trails meet.

232028.note: The pin is on the drawn loop through the open campground (trailers parked along it), and the loop joins the road in.

232031.note: The pin is on a small shelter in open pines 74 m north of the drawn road; dirt tracks show around it, but none plainly enough to trace.

232042.note: The pin is at the edge of the paved loop beside the highway, with the toilet beside it, and the drawn loop reaches it.

232072.note: Under closed canopy inside the drawn loop, neither the photo nor the noisy ground relief shows a pad at the pin or at the Forest Service's point 28 m west-southwest. Not moved.

232124.note: The pin is beside a small building on a gravel pad, and the drawn lanes of the area reach it.

232132.note: The pin is in the open clearing with tents and trailers, inside the drawn loop off the road.

232373.note: The Forest Service's point, 558 m east, is under canopy beside an undrawn lane that forks off the river road, and the ground relief shows no plain group pad there; the pin is still on the road itself. Not moved.

232377.note: The Forest Service's point, 3.1 km west, is under closed canopy beside a river bar with no clearing or pad, and the pin still shows nothing of the group camp. Not moved.

232379.note: The Forest Service's point 67 m northeast falls on a smoother flat bench east of the drawn side road in the ground relief, but neither layer shows a plain group pad, lot or loop there or at the pin. Not moved.

232777.note: The pin sits among open pines inside the drawn loop, whose dirt lane shows at its south end, and the loop joins the road.

232780.note: The pin is on the drawn loop in an open clearing with trailers parked beside it, and the loop joins the road in.

232784.note: The pin sits in open pines with bare ground and a small structure beside it, but the drawn spur stops 35 m west of it; no lane to the pin shows to trace.

232896.note: The pin stays on the levelled clearing the lidar shows west of the North Fork campground lane, reached by the spur traced earlier today. The Forest Service's point (one "North Fork GCG" for both the Bear and Beaver group camps), 225 m northeast, is in forest beside the lane's bend with no clearing, so it is the one that's off. Not moved.

232897.note: The Forest Service's point ("North Fork GCG", shared with the Bear group camp's listing), 185 m south-southwest of the pin, is on a small knoll beside a graded lane the ground relief shows under the canopy, with no pad or loop; the pin stays on the flat smooth patch the relief shows at the lane's north end, which may be the camp's clearing but has no plain edges. The drawn roads don't follow the lane. Not moved.

232898.note: The Forest Service's point, 304 m south, is under closed canopy, and the ground relief shows only rough forest floor there between a graded lane and a creek, no group pad; the pin still shows nothing either. Not moved.

232918.note: The pin is on the green-roofed pavilion of the group area; the paved lane round the west side of its island, from the drawn road up to the pavilion, was traced. The drawn road cuts across the island rather than the east lane, and the listing's own point is 1.4 km away.

233152.note: The pin is on the pavilion between the two drawn parking areas, and the drawn road reaches them.

233160.note: The pin is on the drawn road at the ranger station's buildings by the river, where the cabin stands.

233167.note: The pin sits 25 m east of the green-roofed guard station in the snowy meadow, and the drawn spur off the road reaches the building.

233168.note: The pin is on the guard station building in the snowy meadow, and the drawn road ends beside it.

233203.note: The pin is on the cabin in its small clearing in the forest; the drawn trail passes 40 m west and a footpath joins them, but nothing drawn reaches the cabin.

233209.note: The pin is on the gravel clearing off the highway, and the drawn spur runs through it.

233221.note: Moved the pin about 2 km east onto the group camp ground among oaks, with its toilet building and tables, at the Forest Service's point; the drawn dirt road passes 10 m away on the visible lane. Called usable rather than good at the final check: a group area this open has no one pad to pin.

233230.note: The pin is on the shelter in the clearing inside the drawn loop off the highway.

233259.note: The lidar here is too thin on the terrace to read (1.74 ground points per square meter): inside the Breitenbush bend both layers are mostly interpolation facets, and neither shows the drawn loop or its entrance as a band, so the roads can't be checked to 3 m. The photo shows bare dirt patches beside the pin, 12 m west of the loop, but nothing plainly the group site; nothing was traced.

233285.note: The Forest Service's point 87 m east-northeast is under pines beside the traced spur with nothing at it, and the pin under pines 25 m south of the gravel lot; neither marks the group site plainly. Not moved; the earlier road trace stays.

233288.note: The drawn lanes follow the gravel the photo shows in the open and the bands the lidar relief shows under the trees, but the pin sits in the forest between the two loops, 30 m from either, where neither layer shows a pad, lot or clearing; the nearest levelled ground is a small structure 45 m southwest by the main road. Nothing traced.

233329.note: The pin is on the small guard station building at the foot of the drawn loop, where the trails meet.

233351.note: The pin sits in open ground beside the meadow, between the two buildings and the drawn spur; the spur passes 40 m south and nothing drawn reaches the pin.

233406.note: The pin is on the drawn loop under open pines off the highway, but no clearing or pad at it shows the group site; the restrooms are drawn around the loop.

233681.note: The pin sits in open pines 40 m east of the drawn loop of the group area; no lane to the pin itself shows.

233727.note: The pin is on the cabin's small pale roof in the trees, 25 m off the drawn road that passes it.

233768.note: The pin sits in open pines with tents and small buildings around it; the drawn spur ends 15 m north and a trail passes, but no lane to the pin shows to trace.

233796.note: The pin is in the small clearing inside the drawn loop off the highway, with the restroom beside it.

233797.note: The pin is on the gravel turnaround off the highway, with a small building beside it, and the drawn loop runs around it.

233816.note: The pin sits on the open bench at the end of a short drawn spur, but the spur doesn't follow the visible lane, which runs south from the pin to the meadow track; nothing marks a group site at the pin.

233817.note: The unit's point is about 895 km from the listing's own (Utah): it lands on a campground loop in a granite valley under National Park Service roads, not on any Uinta River group site.

233836.note: The pin is on the gravel turnaround at the end of the drawn road, with trailers parked at the edge of the meadow.

233879.note: The Forest Service's point 83 m west-southwest lands on a junction of the drawn lanes, and the pin beside the loop to the east; neither shows a group site's pad in the photo. Not moved.

233894.note: The Forest Service point matched here is the Ochoco ranger station's rental cabin, a different unit from this group shelter, so it was not used; the pin, on a drawn lane among scattered tents and cars, still shows nothing that is plainly the shelter. Not moved.

233903.note: The pin is on the lawn by the shelter beside the drawn parking lot, but the drawn loop south of it crosses the lawn where no road shows; the listing's own point is 3.3 km away.

233944.note: The pin is on the drawn loop in an open stand beside a small building, and the loop joins the road; the listing's own point is 1.6 km away, but the loop and building fit a crew quarters.

233971.note: The pin is on the red-roofed building inside the drawn loop off the road.

233998.note: The lidar shows the highway and its pull-off as plain bands with the drawn roads on them, and the relief a faint graded lane along the drawn road west of the pin; but the pin sits on ground ringed by small creek channels, with no pad, lot or clearing in either layer, and the listing's own point is 310 m away. Nothing traced.

234084.note: The pin is on the cabin's roof beside the drawn spur up from the highway.

234133.note: The Forest Service's point, 1.7 km south-southeast, lands on a paved lane of a campground in the pines, but no single pad or loop there is plainly the group site, so the pin wasn't moved; it is still in open scrub 410 m from any drawn road.

234146.note: The pin is in the open ball field with the shelter at its southwest corner, and the drawn road ends at the field's edge.

234147.note: The pin sits under trees by the river, 20 m south of the open field with its shelter that is plainly the group site; the drawn lane runs between them.

234178.note: The pin is 30 m east of the lookout on the open ridge, and the drawn trail passes 35 m north of the lookout.

234188.note: The pin is at the end of the drawn spur by the lake, beside a cabin roof in the trees, where the lakeshore trails meet.

234218.note: Neither the pin on the forested floodplain nor the Forest Service's point 73 m northeast, under trees beside the drawn road, shows a group pad or loop in the photo or the lidar relief. Not moved.

234261.note: The pin is on the guard station building in its fenced yard, a few metres from the drawn roads that meet beside it.

234263.note: The pin is beside the guard station buildings in the trees, and the drawn road runs past them.

234270.note: The pin is on the guard station's buildings in the clearing, and the drawn loop off the road reaches them.

234285.note: The pin, moved by units-01 onto the yurt, sits on its round roof and platform, which the photo shows in a small clearing and the dense lidar relief (9.73 ground points per square meter) shows as a levelled pad. The drawn road follows its sunken band within about 3 m and passes 14 m west of the yurt; nothing further was traced or moved.

234286.note: The pin is 20 m behind the guard station's buildings, which stand on the drawn road along the creek.

234310.note: Neither the pin on the drawn lakeshore road nor the Forest Service's point 12 m south (trees and grass by the shore) shows a group pad in the photo or the ground relief; the pale pads 25 to 45 m west are the campground's other sites. Not moved.

234314.note: The pin is on the cabin beside the drawn road through the ranch yard. The listing's own point is 3.4 km away, outside this frame; worth a check that this yard is the cabin's.

234324.note: The pin is on the cabin in the clearing at the foot of the drawn spur off the road.

234325.note: The pin is on the summit rock where the drawn road ends in a loop, with the lookout's shadow beside it.

234420.note: The pin is on a building of the old nursery's yard, inside the drawn loop off the road, among the other buildings.

234440.note: The pin is in the drawn loop on the river bar, among parked trailers and tents, and the loop joins the road.

234508.note: The pin is on the pavilion above the river; the drawn road ends at the parking area 35 m south, and the way up to the pavilion doesn't show plainly enough to trace.

234528.note: The pin is on the guard station cabin at the end of the drawn road up the meadow. The listing's own point is 2.3 km away, but the photo shows the station here.

234573.note: The pin moved 1.1 km south onto the gravel group pads the photo shows off the canyon road, with their shelter 25 m south, beside the Forest Service's point. OpenStreetMap's lane into the pads now reaches the pin, but under the trees it can't be checked, and the drawn canyon road runs 5 to 8 m west of the paved one.

234605.note: The pin is on the guard station building at the end of the drawn spur in the meadow.

234705.note: The lidar (4.56 ground points per square meter) shows the pin on forest floor beside a ditched lane that carries on south-east from the end of the drawn road, 15 to 20 m east of the pin, toward the river; neither layer nor the photo shows a pad, clearing or loop that is plainly the group site, and the intensity here is a uniform mottle. With the site unplaced, the undrawn lane was not traced.

234732.note: The lidar shows the highway as a plain graded band beside the drawn road, but the survey is sparse here (1.48 ground points per square meter) and neither layer shows the two small drawn loops or any pad or clearing at the pin beside them; the photo shows only canopy. Nothing traced.

234749.note: The pin is at the end of the drawn loop on the bench above the river beach, with a cleared pad beside it. The listing's own point is 1 km away, but the photo shows the site here.

234755.note: The pin is on the open pad at the west end of the drawn loop by the meadow, with lanes the loop follows. The listing's own point is 5.6 km away, but this loop is plainly a camp.

234780.note: The Forest Service's point, 315 m east, is in deep shadow under conifers where nothing can be seen, and the pin at the end of the drawn spur still shows no group site. Not moved.

234781.note: The Forest Service's point, 258 m east, is under closed conifers on the river's south bank with no clearing or pad, and the pin still shows nothing of the group site; the lidar is too sparse to help. Not moved.

238333.note: The pin is still on the highway's shoulder with nothing that could be a group camp; the Forest Service's point 242 m west lands on a paved junction by a big parking lot and a restroom, and no group pad can be told there. Not moved.

251360.note: The pin is in the gravel lot where trailers and a building stand, at the junction of the drawn roads.

251582.note: The pin is in an open flat among pines between the drawn lane and the highway, beside visible dirt lanes, but the drawn lane passes 15 m south and doesn't follow the lanes to it.

251611.note: The pin is where the drawn loop meets the road in the open campground, with the paved lanes it follows.

251615.note: The lidar intensity shows the park road's paved loop plainly under the trees, and its north side and hairpin, which OpenStreetMap had 5 to 14 m off, are retraced on the band from the bend nearest the pin to the parking lot at the west end. The pin sits 25 m east of the hairpin on plain forest floor, with no pad, shelter or clearing in either layer or on the photo, so the group area can't be placed.

251711.note: The pin stays on the east corner of the square levelled block the ground relief shows at the end of the drawn spur; the Forest Service's point, 120 m northeast, is on the spur's junction with the highway, where nothing is built, so it is the one that's off. Not moved.

251836.note: The pin is on open desert ground 80 m south of the campground's drawn loop; the loop has several paved pads with small shelters, and nothing marks which one is the group site.

251899.note: A dark-roofed building in a fenced yard, the only building for a kilometer, stands 240 m southeast of the pin just below the end of the drawn track; the pin was in open sagebrush. A trailer and small shed sit just outside the fence.
